=== IPD LITE SCHEMA LEGEND ===

All tables Citus-distributed by iq_tenant_id.
Color: #c8e6c9 = Distributed table

=== TABLE ROLES ===

wards: Clinical areas (ward, daycare, ICU)
beds: Individual beds with status machine
episodes: Core admission/encounter record
clinical_notes: Doctor/nurse SOAP documentation
vital_signs: Parameterised time-series vitals
inpatient_orders: All order types
medication_administrations: eMAR records
nursing_tasks: Shift-based task tracking
transfer_requests: Bed/ward moves
discharge_plans: Discharge checklist (1:1 with episode)
discharge_summaries: Final structured summary
ipd_charges: Running charge items (local queue)

=== KEY RELATIONSHIPS ===

wards 1:N beds | wards 1:N episodes
beds current_episode_id -> episodes.id (occupancy)
episodes 1:N clinical_notes, vital_signs,
         inpatient_orders, nursing_tasks,
         transfer_requests, ipd_charges
episodes 1:1 discharge_plans
inpatient_orders 1:N medication_administrations
